'''''Hope''''' was the name of a [[Scout ship/Legends|scoutship]] used by [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] in her search for a route that would span the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], which later became the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. In [[3701 BBY]], the ''Hope'' was disabled and crash-landed on the remote world of [[Nuvar]], where Kallea remained for six years.
